card.name: Genotype terms before HCV genotype numbers
card.fires_on: The word genotype (often split as Gen-otype or gen-otypes) in hepatitis C dosing text, just before numbers like 1, 2, 3. It also fires on separators inside lists of enzyme or variant names such as CYP2C8/9/10 or V600E or V600K.

modes.label: Genotype word
modes.description: The word genotype or its inner pieces, right before a list of genotype numbers in HCV treatment text.

modes.label: Separators in variant lists
modes.description: A slash, comma or 'or' between enzyme or mutation names, just before the next item.
